claude_proposed_widenings.name: ongoing_operations_on_activated_ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ActivatedAbilityMechanics (the magic-item activation family) has phases but no operations field. The Deck of Illusions requires ongoing operations identical in shape to OngoingEffectMechanics.operations — specifically an on_creature_studies trigger → ability_check_gate for disbelief, and an on_caster_spends_action trigger → reposition_attachment for mid-duration movement. These exact operations encode cleanly in the spell-only ongoing_effect family (as shown by silent_image.dhall), but that family is not available to magic items. No honest encoding exists without either (a) adding an operations field to ActivatedAbilityMechanics, or (b) introducing a new magic-item mechanics family that combines activation cost/resource/reset with ongoing operations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that takes a Study action to visually inspect the illusory creature identifies it as an illusion with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. ... you can take a Magic action to move it anywhere within 30 feet of its card.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.card_moved
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The illusion ends when its card is physically moved (picked up, relocated on the ground). This is distinct from all existing DurationEndTrigger variants: it is not target_makes_attack_roll, target_deals_damage, target_casts_spell, target_dons_armor, target_damaged_by_caster_or_ally, target_takes_damage, or caster_recasts_spell. It is an object-interaction trigger on the attachment anchor (the card on the ground) — no current variant covers this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The illusion lasts until its card is moved or the illusion is dispelled (using a Dispel Magic spell or a similar effect).
